question: What forms the seat of worship and why do the powers assume it?
premises: The triad of lotuses together with unmanā functions as the seat.
They do so from a desire to cut off their mutual difference.
inference: The lotus triad and unmanā serve as the ritual seat because the powers seek to transcend their mutual differentiation.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically compressed; the causal link is inferred from the instrumental.
plain_english: The triad of lotuses together with unmanā becomes the seat, as the powers take it up out of a desire to cut away their mutual difference.
